				}

}

					is_hive_empire = yes
				}
			}
			minerals = 2
		}
		upkeep = {

				is_lithoid = yes
				owner = {
					is_machine_empire = yes
				}
			}
			energy = 2
		}
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = {
			always = yes
		}
		planet_amenities_no_happiness_add = 50
	}
	weight = {
		weight = @simple_drone_job_weight
	}
	category = simple_drone
